material_changes: Host-smoke runner records replayable observed_value, observed_stdout_text, and observed_value_key fields on mdconfig/fstyp authority rows.
Host-smoke receipt validator recomputes mdconfig/fstyp stdout_sha256 from observed_stdout_text and rejects authority-token drift.
Validator requires the mdconfig-emitted md unit to be used by fstyp, read-only mount, and mdconfig detach before worker launch.
Release-critical host-smoke checker includes tamper regressions for mdconfig stdout replay drift and detach-target drift.
Proof-bundle example, cube generated artifacts, and front doors were refreshed for 2026-06-13r571 while preserving the front-door budget.
open_risks: Real non-simulated FreeBSD host proof is still absent.
The host-proof path is stricter, but still needs an actual FreeBSD run and bundle import.
docs/00-index.md remains at the line budget and close to the byte budget.
Canonical JSON remains the restricted no-float profile, not full arbitrary-number RFC 8785 JCS.
summary: Rev0540 hardens the FreeBSD host-proof path by making mdconfig/fstyp media authority replayable and binding the mdconfig-emitted md unit through fstyp, mount, and detach before worker launch.
